_about: WoW Forever secrets for the Collectables tab and the add-on's Questie pins. Facts gathered from news and guide sites (see SOURCES.md), written in our own words; quest, item and NPC ids and spots from AllTheThings' Forever data (MIT) where it has them, dungeon entrances from the classic maps. 'have' says how the game shows it's done: a completed quest, an item you own (by id, or by name for new items whose id isn't public), every item of a set, a toy or a pet learned. 'parts' are items picked up along the way. Built into collections-forever.json and CollectionsData.lua by build_library_books.py.

secrets.name: Night Watchman's Torch
secrets.about: A toy torch you can hold (not in cities; it goes out in combat or water). A dead Night Watch guard appears in Duskwood at night, often behind the biggest building in Raven Hill, but he moves between several spots. Click him for the quick quest An Unfortunate End. Lose it and you can get another. Needed for the Befouled Water Globe secret.

secrets.name: Musical Gustjumper
secrets.about: A singing frog companion. On Zephras Isle, at the top of the waterfall, target the frogs singing on the rock and /sing (at least two frogs must be on the rock). One hops onto the log next to you: click it. It isn't soulbound, so you can get more and trade or sell them.

secrets.name: Befouled Water Globe
secrets.about: Solved by the WoW Secret Finding Discord. You need the Ancient Heirloom ring (Skyborne characters get it from their first quest; anyone can take one from the top floor of the tower) and the Night Watchman's Torch. With the torch, reveal the Ancient Hilt at the back of the Ruins of Ban'aethal, collect the Ancient Skyborne Blades around the isle, then click the Befouled Water Globe to get the Cleansed Water Globe.

secrets.name: Druid Serpent Form
secrets.about: Wear all five pieces of the Embrace of the Viper set from Wailing Caverns and Cat Form becomes a serpent. The tooltip doesn't say so.

secrets.name: Mutanus the Devourer
secrets.about: A hidden boss in Wailing Caverns: he only appears once all four Lords of the Fang are dead. The game doesn't report the kill: tick it here.

secrets.name: Rockslicer
secrets.about: Rhahk'Zor's two-handed axe in the Deadmines now mines Copper, Tin, Silver and Iron veins without the Mining skill.

secrets.name: Coldflame Saber
secrets.about: A Mage-only sword whose melee attacks deal extra fire damage to frozen targets. From level 6, Comprehend Scroll on the untranslated scrolls you find until one is the Scroll of the Saber; farm Baron Silverlaine in Shadowfang Keep for the Blade of Silverlaine; use the scroll on the blade.

secrets.name: Lyn the Ignored
secrets.about: Take the Black Tome from the table next to Archmage Arugal at the end of Shadowfang Keep (everyone in the group can loot one). Use it at the Leyline Focus next to Archmage Ataeric in the Ambermill town hall, then use what it makes on the purple ritual circle in the lower level of the City of Dalaran to summon Lyn the Ignored. The game doesn't report the kill: tick it here.

secrets.name: Ruins of Lordaeron secret bosses
secrets.about: Two hidden bosses in the Ruins of Lordaeron dungeon: summon The Abandoned at a glowing knight statue, and Viktor the Vile from the fireplace of a ruined house. The game doesn't report the kills: tick it here.

secrets.name: Malignant Root ring
secrets.about: Nightveiled Rotheaps in the Wetlands drop Rotheap Innards. Bring them to Rethiel the Greenwarden and pick the extra dialogue option to trade them for the ring. No quest or reputation needed.

secrets.name: Applejack Still
secrets.about: A still in western Elwynn Forest turns 4 Shiny Red Apples into a drink. Repeatable.

secrets.name: Silver of the Waves
secrets.about: A hidden quest that starts from a silver hair clip whose only clue is two initials. It ends in Loch Modan.

secrets.name: Whispering Horror Residue
secrets.about: A level 11 elite in a cellar in western Tirisfal Glades drops an item that starts this quest.

secrets.name: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure
secrets.about: A treasure map that drops in Westfall leads to four clues along the coast; the chest now holds a new Forever reward.

secrets.name: The Black Market
secrets.about: In the goblin harbor of Powderfuse Port (boat from Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris), two Agents of the Black Market: Madam Swyndle runs a black market auction house, Mister Graphed sells rare crafting materials and the Gift of Galloping (a 15-day mount speed buff). Stock rotates. Tick it once you've found it.

secrets.name: Keystone Fragment and Stone Key
secrets.about: Not solved yet. A Torn Page and a knife (a barrel inside the sewers' back entrance, or an open book; guides differ) give the Keystone Fragment. In Blackrock Mountain, in the corridors toward Upper Blackrock Spire, a Scarshield Grunt who won't attack guards a satchel: use the fragment there for the Stone Key. What it opens isn't known.

secrets.name: Taldramir, the Whispering Wood
secrets.about: WoW Forever's first legendary, a staff, expected in spring 2027 from a Moonglade quest line (an Elune ritual with the Cenarion Circle). Known from datamining only.
